exquisite words to add to
your vocabulary
(part 3)

ethereal
adjective — extremely delicate and light
"the morning fog looked ethereal over the lake."

sagacious
adjective — wise, with good judgement
"a sagacious friend tells you to start early."

ardent
adjective — very enthusiastic
"an ardent reader finishes a book a week."

lethargic
adjective — sluggish and without energy
"i feel lethargic after a whole day of scrolling."

profound
adjective — very deep or great
"her answer was short but profound."
